y-m-54-05.title: Shin yana da kyau a ninka ɓangarorin biyu da x?
y-m-54-05.topic: Sharadin da za a bincika kafin ninka da canji a rashin daidaiton kaso.
y-m-54-05.goal: Kai da kanka ka samar da misalin karyatawa ga hukuncin x<3 da aka samu ta ninka 6/x>2 da x, sannan ka sake rubuta mafitar la’akari da cewa alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito ta danganta da alamar x.
y-m-54-05.material: Jiho ya rubuta haka yayin warware rashin daidaito 6/x>2 (x lambar gaske ce marar sifili): “Idan na ninka ɓangarorin biyu da x, 6>2x, saboda haka x<3. Don haka x=−1 ma mafita ce.” Ana karanta 6/x da “6 bisa x”.
y-m-54-05.thinking.2: Raba sharudda, sannan ka gyara hukunci.
y-m-54-05.prereq.0: Wannan aikin yana ɗauka cewa an ware shi ga matakin wahala H2 na waƙar “Lissafi na Asali 1 na makarantar sakandare” kuma ba ya nuna a wane aji ake koyon batu (tsarin makarantu ya bambanta). Ana ɗauka an san rashin daidaiton layi a matakin sakandare (ninka da lamba mara kyau yana juya alamar rashin daidaito) da lissafin ƙimomin furucin kaso.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.prompt: Muna son duba ko hukuncin Jiho “idan x<3, to 6/x>2” daidai ne. Zaɓi matakin farko da ya dace.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.hint.0: Raba ƙimomin x<3 zuwa masu kyau da marasa kyau, sannan ka zaɓi biyu ko uku daga kowane rukuni.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.hint.1: Saka kowace ƙima a 6/x, sannan ka tsara a tebur ko ta fi ko ta gaza 2.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.a: Ninka ɓangarorin biyu da 2 ka duba ko furucin sun yi daidai.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.a: Sabon furuci da aka samar ta ninka ɓangarorin biyu da lamba ɗaya ba shi da alaƙa kai tsaye da gaskiya ko ƙaryar asalin hukuncin.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.b: Saka x=3, ka duba ko ɓangarorin biyu sun yi daidai.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.b: Duba ƙimar iyaka kaɗai ba ya gwada dukkan x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.c: Raba 6/x da x domin sauƙaƙa furucin.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.c: Hakan yana ƙara rikitar da furuci ne kawai, ba aikin gwada hukunci ba ne.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.o.d: Saka wasu ƙimomi x<3 cikin asalin rashin daidaito.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hanya ce da ke gwada wasu daga cikin shari’o’in da hukuncin ke magana a kansu kai tsaye.
y-m-54-05.s.s1.explain: Ikirarin “idan x<3, yana aiki koyaushe” zai karye idan ko ƙima guda x<3 ba ta sa rashin daidaiton ya tabbata ba. Saka ƙimomi kai tsaye a asalin rashin daidaiton 6/x>2 ita ce hanya mafi kai tsaye.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da lambobi cikakku 2 daban-daban x waɗanda suka cika hukuncin Jiho x<3 amma ba su cika asalin rashin daidaiton 6/x>2 ba. (x lamba cikakkiya ce daga -50 zuwa 50, kuma x ba 0 ba ne.)
y-m-54-05.s.s2.hint.0: Saka lamba cikakkiya mara kyau ɗaya da tabbatacciya ɗaya inda x<3 cikin 6/x.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.hint.1: Duba ko 6/x ya fi 2 tare da alamarsa.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.ok.c1: x lamba cikakkiya ce cikin zangon, kuma ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.fail.c1: x dole ta zama lamba cikakkiya marar sifili daga -50 zuwa 50.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.ok.c3: 6/x bai wuce 2 ba; saboda haka asalin rashin daidaito bai tabbata ba.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.fail.c3: 6/x ya fi 2; saboda haka asalin rashin daidaito ya tabbata. Wannan ba misalin karyatawa ba ne.
y-m-54-05.s.s2.explain: Idan x=−1, 6/x=−6 ne, kuma −6 bai fi 2 ba. Ko da x<3, akwai ƙimomi da rashin daidaiton bai tabbata ba; saboda haka hukuncin Jiho ba daidai ba ne. Waɗannan ƙimomin duk marasa kyau ne.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.prompt: Gyara mafitar Jiho. Ka haɗa bayyana inda matsalar take da zangon mafitar da aka samu daidai.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta furucin da ake samu idan aka ninka ɓangarorin biyu da x dabam idan x tabbatacciya ce da idan x mara kyau ce.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko x=−1 yana cikin sakamakon da aka haɗa daga shari’o’in biyun.

y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka tantance alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito dabam a kowane shari’a?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka duba cewa zangon mafitarka bai ƙunshi x=−1 ba, wanda Jiho ya samu da kuskure?
y-m-54-05.s.s3.model.0: Matsalar ita ce ka ninka da x ba tare da sanin alamarsa ba. Idan x mara kyau ce, alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito tana juyawa. Sai idan x>0 ne za a samu 6>2x; saboda haka mafita ita ce 0<x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.model.1: Idan x>0, to 6>2x, saboda haka 0<x<3. Idan x<0 ne, alamar rashin daidaito tana juyawa zuwa 6<2x, wato x>3, amma hakan bai haɗu da x<0 ba; saboda haka babu mafita. Mafitar ita ce 0<x<3.
y-m-54-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: An kuma lissafta shari’ar marar kyau dabam, aka nuna cewa babu mafita.

y-m-54-03.title: Idan aka sauya k, ta yaya mafita suke sauyawa?
y-m-54-03.topic: Yawan tushen gaske na ma’aunin murabba’i x²−4x+k=0, da ƙimomin k da ke ba da tushen lambobi cikakku
y-m-54-03.goal: Duba yadda yawan tushen gaske na ma’aunin murabba’i mai harafin k ke sauyawa da k, kai da kanka ka samar da ƙimomin k da ke ba da tushen lambobi cikakku biyu daban-daban, sannan ka bayyana ƙa’idar.
y-m-54-03.material: A ma’aunin x²−4x+k=0, k lamba cikakkiya ce, mafita kuma ana dubanta cikin lambobin gaske. Idan aka sauya k, yawan mafita da sigarsu suna sauyawa. Subin ta yanke shawarar nemo mafita yayin sauya k zuwa 0, 3, 4, 5, -1. Ana karanta x²−4x+k da “x murabba’i a cire 4x a ƙara k”.
y-m-54-03.thinking.0: Saka ƙimomi a madadin k, sannan ka kwatanta yawan tushen.
y-m-54-03.thinking.2: Bayyana ƙa’idar daga misalan da aka samo.

Ana ɗauka an san warware ma’aunai murabba’i a matakin sakandare (rarraba zuwa abubuwa, dabarar murabba’i) da ma’anar lambobin murabba’i (1, 4, 9, 16, ...).

y-m-54-03.s.s1.hint.0: Saka ƙimar k ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka sake rubuta ma’aunin a sigar (x−2)²=(wata ƙima).

y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.d: Hanya ce da ke duba ta warwarewa kai tsaye ko mafita biyu daban-daban za su samu.

y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.c: Wataƙila ka yi tunanin cewa idan k ya fi girma, mafita za su ƙaru. A ma’aunin x²−4x+5=0, duba ƙimar da (x−2)² dole ta zama.
y-m-54-03.s.s1.r.e: Ba ka manta cewa k mara kyau ma na iya ba da mafita ba.

y-m-54-03.s.s2.prompt: Shigar da lambobi cikakku k guda 3 inda x²−4x+k=0 ke da tushen lambobi cikakku biyu daban-daban. (k lamba cikakkiya ce ba ta ƙasa da -60 ba, mafita kuma lambobi cikakku biyu ne daban-daban cikin lambobin gaske.)
y-m-54-03.s.s2.hint.0: Duba ƙoefishan x²−4x, sannan ka yi tunanin jimillar mafita biyun dole ta zama nawa.

y-m-54-03.s.s2.explain: Idan k=0, mafita su ne 0, 4. Idan k=3, su ne 1, 3. Idan k=-5, su ne -1, 5. Idan k=-12, su ne -2, 6. A dukkaninsu jimillar mafita 4 ce, samfurinsu kuma k ne. Idan k=1 ko 2, mafita ba lambobi cikakku ba ne.
y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Wace ƙa’ida ce k ɗin da ka samo suke bi? Ka kuma yi bayani da aƙalla misalin lamba guda dalilin da ya sa k=1 ko k=2 ba sa aiki.

y-m-54-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Wata hanya ce da ta bayyana ta ko ƙimar lissafi lambar murabba’i ce, maimakon jimilla da samfur.

y-m-54-02.topic: Yawan mafita na ma'auni mai layi tare da harafi a cikin ƙididdiga
y-m-54-02.goal: Koyi cewa adadin hanyoyin magance ma'auni kamar (a-2)x=b-3 yana canzawa tare da a da b, yanke hukunci akan abin da kuke buƙatar sani kafin bayyana mafita, kuma kuyi a da b waɗanda suka dace da yanayin da kanku.
y-m-54-02.material: Akwai ma'auni (a-2) x = b-3 a cikin x. a da b lambobi ne (masu ƙima) waɗanda har yanzu ba a yanke shawarar ƙimar su ba. Harin ya ce, "Idan kun raba bangarorin biyu ta a-2, za ku sami x=(b-3)/(a-2), don haka akwai mafita guda daya," kuma Ujin ya ce, "Zai iya canzawa dangane da a." (a-2)x ana karanta shi azaman 'a debe sau 2, sau x.'
y-m-54-02.thinking.1: Bayar da ƙarshen ƙarshe waɗanda ke canzawa tare da yanayi
y-m-54-02.thinking.2: Yin misalan da suka gamsar da sharuɗɗan
y-m-54-02.prereq.0: Wannan aikin yana ɗaukar aikin wahala (H2) na 'waƙar Basic Math 1' na makarantar sakandare kuma baya nuna a wane aji ake koyon abun ciki (tsarin makaranta ya bambanta). Magance matakin makarantar tsakiya na daidaitattun layi da gaskiyar cewa 'ba za ku iya raba ta 0 ba.'
y-m-54-02.s.s1.prompt: Kuna so ku faɗi maganin wannan ma'auni azaman ƙima ɗaya ba tare da sanin ƙimar a da b. Zaɓi abin da ya fi dacewa da kuke buƙatar sani.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya darajoji kamar 3 da 2 don ɗaya bayan ɗaya kuma rubuta yadda lissafin ke canzawa.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunani ko akwai buƙatar sharadi akan lambar lokacin da kuka raba bangarorin biyu da lamba ɗaya.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.a: Ya isa sanin kawai ko b shine 3
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.a: Idan kun saita b = 3 gefen dama ya zama 0, amma ƙarshen ya sake canzawa dangane da ko ƙididdiga na hagu shine 0.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.b: Muna buƙatar sanin ko a-2 shine 0 ko a'a
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.b: Kuna ganin yanayin da ke kan lambar da kuka raba ta na iya raba ƙarshe.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.c: Ya isa a san cewa a da b duka lambobi cikakku ne kawai.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.c: Kasancewar lamba cikakkiya ba ya shafar yawan mafita. Idan a=2 ne, ita ma lamba cikakkiya ce.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.o.d: Ya isa a san ko x tabbatacciya ce kawai.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.r.d: Sanin alamar x ya yi nisa da bayanin da ke raba yawan mafita. Duba ɓangaren ƙoefishan.
y-m-54-02.s.s1.explain: Idan ƙoefishan a−2 na x ba 0 ba ne, ana iya rabawa kuma mafita guda ɗaya ce. Idan a−2=0 ne, ma’aunin ya zama 0·x=b−3; idan b−3=0, mafita marasa iyaka ne, in ba haka ba babu mafita. Saboda haka ya kamata a san ko a−2=0 ne.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.prompt: Kayyade lambobi cikakku a da b da za su sa ma’aunin (a−2)x=b−3 ba shi da mafita ko kaɗan, sannan ka shigar da misalai 2 daban-daban. (a da b lambobi cikakku ne daga -20 zuwa 20.)
y-m-54-02.s.s2.hint.0: Saka 2 a madadin a domin sauƙaƙa gefen hagu, sannan ka duba ko zai ba da ƙima iri ɗaya ga kowace x da ka saka.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.hint.1: Raba shari’ar da gefen dama b−3 yake 0 da wadda ba 0 ba, sannan ka saka ƙimar x guda kai tsaye.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Idan ƙoefishan a−2 na x ba 0 ba ne, mafita guda ɗaya ce.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.ok.c3: 0·x daidai yake da lamba marar sifili, saboda haka babu mafita.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan gefen dama 0 ne, mafita marasa iyaka ne. Gwada sa gefen dama ya zama lamba marar sifili.
y-m-54-02.s.s2.explain: Idan a=2 ne, gefen hagu 0·x=0 ne; idan gefen dama b−3 lamba marar sifili ce, babu x da zai cika, saboda haka babu mafita. Idan b=3 ne, kowace x mafita ce. Idan a ba 2 ba ne, mafita guda ɗaya ce.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.prompt: Rubuta amsar da za a aika wa Harin. Ka bayyana shari’ar da maganar Harin “koyaushe mafita guda ɗaya ce” ba ta aiki, da abin da ke faruwa da mafita a wannan shari’ar.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta ƙimar da “lambar da ake rabawa da ita” a lissafin Harin za ta iya samu.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo a da ke sa wannan ƙimar ta zama 0, sannan ka rubuta siffar da ma’aunin ke ɗauka.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta ta hanyar raba shari’ar a=2 da wadda a ba 2 ba?
y-m-54-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka nuna cewa idan a=2, sakamakon ya bambanta bisa ko b−3=0 ne ko ba haka ba?
y-m-54-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Bayyaninka ya nuna cewa mafitar Harin (rabawa) ba kuskure ba ce, amma “ba a duba sharadin” ne ya ɓace?
y-m-54-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan a=2, to a−2=0; saboda haka ba za a iya raba ɓangarorin biyu da shi ba. Sai ya zama 0·x=b−3; idan b ba 3 ba ne babu mafita, idan b=3 ne kowace x mafita ce. Sai idan a ba 2 ba ne za a sami mafita guda ɗaya, x=(b−3)/(a−2).
y-m-54-02.s.s3.model.1: Kafin rabawa, dole a duba ko a=2 ne. Idan a=2 ne, za a raba da 0 wanda ba ya halatta; sannan idan b=3 mafita marasa iyaka ne, idan b ba 3 ba ne babu mafita. Idan a ba 2 ba ne, mafita guda ɗaya ce kamar yadda Harin ta ce.
y-m-54-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Tsarin raba shari’o’i ne kawai ya bambanta; abin da aka bayyana iri ɗaya ne.

y-m-54-04.title: Me ya sa ɗaya daga cikin ƙimomin ba mafita ba ce?
y-m-54-04.topic: Tabbatar da ƙimomin da aka samu yayin warware ma’aunin cikakkiyar ƙima.
y-m-54-04.goal: Nemo inda zato “kowace ƙima da aka samu ta hanyar warwarewa mafita ce” ya karye a mafitar |x−1|=2x, sannan ka yi bayani da kalmominka dalilin da ya sa mafita guda ɗaya kawai ta rage.
y-m-54-04.material: Seoa ta warware ma’aunin |x−1|=2x. x lamba ce ta gaske. Ana karanta |x−1| da “cikakkiyar ƙimar x cire 1”. Ga mafitar Seoa a ƙasa.
y-m-54-04.thinking.1: Tabbatar da sakamakon ta hanyar maye gurbi.
y-m-54-04.thinking.2: Nuna hukunci iri ɗaya da wata hanya.
y-m-54-04.prereq.0: Wannan aikin yana ɗauka cewa an ware shi ga matakin wahala H2 na waƙar “Lissafi na Asali 1 na makarantar sakandare” kuma ba ya nuna a wane aji ake koyon batu (tsarin makarantu ya bambanta). Ana ɗauka an san ma’anar cikakkiyar ƙima (tazara daga 0 a layin lambobi, koyaushe 0 ko fiye) da warware ma’aunin layi a matakin sakandare.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda marar daidai a mafitar Seoa. (An ƙidaya layuka daga 1.)
y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.0: Sake warware layuka na 1 zuwa 3 domin duba lissafi ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan ka duba sabon ikirarin da aka yi a layukan bayansu.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.hint.1: Saka ƙimomin biyu ɗaya bayan ɗaya cikin asalin ma’aunin |x−1|=2x, sannan ka lissafta ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.2: Daga x−1=−2x, 3x=1 ne, saboda haka x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka mafita su ne x=−1 ko x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.line.4: Waɗannan su ne ƙimomin biyu da aka samu ta warwarewa, saboda haka duka mafita ne ga wannan ma’auni.
y-m-54-04.s.s1.explain: Layuka na 4 da 5. A yayin warwarewa, babu tabbacin cewa mafitar furucin da aka samu ta raba shari’o’i mafita ce ga asalin ma’aunin. Idan aka saka x=−1 a asalin ma’auni, gefen hagu |-2|=2 ne, gefen dama kuma 2×(−1)=−2; sun bambanta. Ga x=1/3, gefen hagu 2/3 ne, dama kuma 2/3, sun yi daidai.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.prompt: Idan aka saka x=−1 a asalin ma’auni, gefen hagu |-1−1|=2 ne, dama kuma 2×(−1)=−2. Zaɓi abin da ya fi dacewa a faɗa daga wannan sakamako.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin ƙaramin ƙimar da gefen hagu |x−1| zai iya samu.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika ko ma’aunin zai iya tabbata a yankin x inda gefen dama 2x yake mara kyau.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.a: |x−1| ba ta da ƙasa da 0, amma 2x mara kyau ne, saboda haka ba su dace ba.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da ya fara duba zangon ƙimomin da ɗaya daga cikin ɓangarorin ma’aunin zai iya samu.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.b: Saboda cikakkiyar ƙima tana iya ɗaukar lambobi masu alamomi daban-daban a matsayin ƙima ɗaya, wannan ma mafita ce.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.b: Cikakkiyar ƙima tana cire alama daga gefen hagu kawai. Ba ta shafi gefen dama 2x ba.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.c: An yi kuskuren lissafi; idan aka sake warwarewa, ƙimomin biyun mafita ne.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.c: Idan ka kira sakamakon kuskure alhali lissafin maye gurbin daidai ne, wataƙila ba ka amince da sakamakon da ka bincika ba.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.o.d: x=−1 mafita ce, x=1/3 kuma ba mafita ba ce.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.r.d: Wataƙila ka zaɓi ƙima guda ɗaya ba tare da maye gurbin ƙimomin biyun ka bincika ba. Saka 1/3 ma.
y-m-54-04.s.s2.explain: |x−1| koyaushe ba ta da ƙasa da 0; saboda haka 2x ma dole ya zama ba ƙasa da 0 ba. Ga x=−1, 2x mara kyau ne kuma bai dace ba; ga x=1/3 ɓangarorin biyu 2/3 ne. Don haka mafita guda ɗaya ita ce x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.prompt: Maimakon hanyar Seoa, rubuta wata hanya guda da ke nuna cewa x=1/3 ita ce mafita guda ɗaya. Misali: fara tantance zangon x ko raba zuwa x≥1 da x<1. Ka kuma bayyana dalilin da ya sa x=−1 ba mafita ba ce.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.0: Saka x=−1 a ɓangarorin asalin ma’aunin biyu, sannan ka kwatanta alamominsu.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin mafi ƙarancin ƙimar da cikakkiyar ƙima za ta iya samu, sannan ka rubuta sharadin da hakan ya dora wa furucin dama.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Za ka iya bayyana yadda hanyata ta sanya “dalilin cire mafita” a wani wuri daban da hanyar Seoa?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar ta maye gurbi a asalin ma’aunin cewa x=1/3 mafita ce da gaske?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Dalilin cire x=−1 ya bayyana, ko ta zangon ƙima ko ta maye gurbi?
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.0: |x−1| ba ta da ƙasa da 0, saboda haka 2x ma dole ya zama ba ƙasa da 0 ba; don haka x≥0. Sai a cire x=−1, x=1/3 kawai ya rage. Idan aka saka 1/3, ɓangarorin biyu sun yi daidai da 2/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.model.1: Idan x≥1, x−1=2x yana ba da x=−1, amma wannan bai cika x≥1 ba, saboda haka ba ya aiki. Idan x<1, 1−x=2x yana ba da x=1/3, kuma ya cika x<1. Don haka mafita guda ɗaya ita ce x=1/3.
y-m-54-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ya kai ga hukunci iri ɗaya ta hanyar raba zangon ƙima.

y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za ka iya faɗa tabbatacce yanzu game da x-ɗin da ke cika f(x)<0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.after: f(0)=−3<0, saboda haka x=0 tabbas yana ciki. Siffar U ce, f(−2) da f(4) kuma tabbatattu ne, don haka x-ɗin da f(x)<0 zai iya kasancewa tsakanin −2 da 4 kawai. Amma ba mu san ainihin iyakokin ba tukuna. “c” da “d” gaskiyoyi ne dabam-dabam da za a iya faɗa tabbatacce yanzu.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: x=0 kaɗai ne ke cika f(x)<0.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka ɗauki maki da aka gwada a matsayin mafita kawai. Har yanzu ba mu san ƙimomin tsakanin maki ba, amma za mu iya amfani da sifar U.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yanke cewa dukkan ciki mara kyau ne saboda ƙarshen suna da ƙima mai kyau. Har yanzu ba mu san ƙimomin tsakanin 0 da −2 ba.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Idan akwai x da ke cika f(x)<0, dukkansu suna tsakanin −2 da 4.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wannan tunani ne da ya haɗa sifar U da alamomin ƙimomin a iyaka.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Me kake tunani yanzu game da kewayon x da ke cika f(x)<0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.after: A sifar U, f=0 a −1 da 3, saboda haka tsakanin su yana da ƙima mara kyau, wajensu kuma tabbatacciya. f(x)<0 na nufin “ƙasa da 0”, saboda haka iyakokin −1 da 3 ba sa ciki, mafita −1<x<3 ce. Ba ta saɓa da x=0 da ka ce tabbatacce ne a matakin baya domin yana cikin kewayon.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka juya tazarar ƙimar mara kyau da tabbatacciya ta sifar U. Duba ko ta dace da f(0)=−3.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ko da ka ga f=0 a iyakoki −1 da 3, ka haɗa su ƙarƙashin sharadin “ƙasa da 0”.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka ɗauki maki f=0 kawai a matsayin mafita. Waɗannan ƙimomi ba ƙasa da 0 ba ne.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Sharadin ya canza. Wannan aikin f(x)=x²−2x−3 ne. (Za ka iya tabbatar ta lissafi kai tsaye cewa ya dace da kowace ƙimar tebur.) Yanzu ana neman kewayon x da f(x)≤0, wato “0 ko ƙasa”.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me kake tunani yanzu game da kewayon x da ke cika f(x)≤0?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.after: f(−1)=0 da f(3)=0 suma 0 ko ƙasa ne, saboda haka an haɗa iyakokin, −1≤x≤3. Idan alamar ta sauya daga < zuwa ≤, ƙimomin iyaka sun shiga mafita.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ba ka la’akari da cewa ≤ ya haɗa “daidai”. Duba f(−1) da f(3).
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ga ≤ ka sauya zuwa tazarorin waje. Duba ko f(0)=−3 yana 0 ko ƙasa.
y-m-54-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka ɗauki maki tabbatacce kaɗai a matsayin mafita. Shin ƙimomin ciki duk 0 ko ƙasa ne?
y-m-54-09.s.s1.reflect: Daga ƙimomi kaɗan a tebur, za ka iya bambanta “abin da ya tabbata (alamar ƙimomin aiki, kewayon da aka samu daga sifar U)” da “abin da ba a sani ba tukuna (ainihin iyakoki)”; idan bayani ya ƙaru, kewayon tabbatacce yana takaita.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.prompt: Wannan ita ce mafitar Seungu da ta nemo f(x)<0 ga f(x)=x²−2x−3. Zaɓi layi guda mai kuskure. (Ana ƙirga layuka daga 1.)
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.0: Saka x=−3 cikin sakamakon layi na 4, x<3, ka lissafa ko rashin daidaito na asali f(x)<0 yana aiki.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tsara a tebur haɗuwar alamomin da ke sa samfurin ya zama mara kyau.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.2: Samfurin mara kyau ne, saboda haka x+1<0 ko x−3<0.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka x<−1 ko x<3, wato x<3.
y-m-54-09.s.s2.explain: Layi na 3 ne (da layi na 4 da ya biyo bayansa) matsalar. Domin samfurin ya zama mara kyau, alamomin abubuwan ninkawa biyu dole su bambanta. Idan aka ce “aƙalla ɗaya daga ciki mara kyau ne”, an haɗa yanayin da duka biyun marasa kyau ne, wanda samfurin tabbatacce ne. Misali x=−3 yana ba da (−2)(−6)=12, tabbatacce. Amsa madaidaiciya −1<x<3 ce. (Zaɓar layi na 3 ko 4 duka ana karɓa.)
